caption: A garage door rolls up in the morning, and daylight moves across the floor from the front to the back as the door opens.

sa.check: A garage door is shut in the morning.
Daylight moves across the floor from the front to the back.
The rear of the garage brightens last.

pc.expect: The lit region on the floor grows inward as the door rises and the rear brightens last.
pc.fail: The rear brightens first; or the floor is lit with the door shut; or the lit region shrinks as the door rises.

pc.expect: The lit region moves only as the door moves.
pc.fail: It grows with the door still; or before the door moves; or flickers.

pc.expect: The door rises steadily and the light grows with it.
pc.fail: The door jumps; or reverses; or the light jumps.

pc.expect: The lit region is a band across the floor spreading from the doorway.
pc.fail: It is a round spot; or splits; or is on the ceiling only.
A second door appears; or the garage vanishes; or the door passes through the frame.

pc.expect: The garage and its contents stay the same.
pc.fail: Items rearrange; or the walls change; or the door changes colour.
